facts.business: Jullundur Motor Agency (Delhi) Limited is engaged in the trading and distribution of auto spare parts for commercial and passenger vehicles across India.

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company is in the process of adding more products / lines in product mix and is focusing to open new outlets/ sales units in potential tier-II & tier-III cities / towns across the country to cater to the areas which have remained uncovered so far.
guidance_or_targets.value: New outlets in tier-II & tier-III cities

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company will continue to invest in technology to help increase efficiency.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts

key_risks: Aftermarket demand tilting towards OEM branded aftermarket products due to aggressive posture by OEMs
Increased competition from new entrants and expansion of product lines by existing players
Working capital increased considerably due to higher prices and larger product range affecting cash flows
Replacement timeframe for aftermarket spares widening due to continuous improvement in technology and quality of parts
Reduced wear and tear on vehicles due to improvement in roads and infrastructure leading to higher life expectancy of parts
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties were in ordinary course of business and at arm's length basis. All transactions reviewed and approved by Audit Committee and Board. No material significant related party transactions that may have potential conflict of interest. Details as per IND AS-24 in notes to accounts. Form AOC-2 annexed.
